raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fix automatic tensor-parallel (TP) selection for models with heterogeneous per-layer attention configurations, such as Gemma 4.

Previously, accessing the global `num_key_value_heads` attribute raised an exception, causing the Recipes tool to fall back to TP=1.

Follow-up to [[PR #60170](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60170)](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60170).

## Claims

- Extract attention-head and KV-head constraints from individual layers.
- Support heterogeneous attention models without TP detection failures.
- Preserve existing TP compatibility checks and homogeneous model support.

## Validation

- Three targeted model tests passed.
- Gemma 4 on Xeon 6 (4 NUMA nodes): correctly selected TP=4 and initialized all four workers.
- Gemma 4 TP=4 subsequently encountered a KV-cache capacity issue; DiffusionGemma TP=2 encountered a runtime warmup stall. Both are outside the scope of this fix.

## Details

The original implementation assumed globally uniform KV-head counts. Models with heterogeneous attention configurations reject this global attribute access.

The fix extracts head constraints from each attention layer and uses the existing TP selection logic to determine a compatible TP size. No changes to inference kernels or distributed execution are required.

---

-            )
+    # Prefer resolved per-layer values for heterogeneous attention. Accessing
+    # global KV-head attributes may raise on recent Transformers configurations.
+    per_layer = getattr(text, "per_layer_config", None)
+    if per_layer is not None:
+        layers = (
+            per_layer.items() if hasattr(per_layer, "items") else enumerate(per_layer)
         )
+    else:
+        layers = (("text", text),)
+
+    text_constraint_count = 0
+    for name, layer in layers:
+        heads_value = getattr(layer, "num_attention_heads", None)
+        kv_value = getattr(layer, "num_key_value_heads", None)
+        # Non-attention layers may not specify either value.
+        if per_layer is not None and heads_value is None and kv_value is None:
+            continue
+        heads = _positive_int(heads_value, f"{name} attention heads")
+        kv = _positive_int(heads if kv_value is None else kv_value, f"{name} KV heads")
+        constraints.append(HeadConstraint(str(name), heads, kv))
+        text_constraint_count += 1
+
+        global_kv = getattr(layer, "num_global_key_value_heads", None)
+        if global_kv is not None:
+            constraints.append(
+                HeadConstraint(
+                    f"{name} global attention",
+                    heads,
+                    _positive_int(global_kv, f"{name} global KV"),
+                )
+            )
+
+        # Hybrid linear-attention layers can impose additional head constraints.
+        for field in ("linear_num_key_heads", "linear_num_value_heads"):
+            count = getattr(layer, field, None)
+            if count is not None:
+                count = _positive_int(count, f"{name} {field}")
+                constraints.append(HeadConstraint(f"{name} {field}", count, count))
